internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The 37 tokens tagged to root ا-ل-و do not form one semantic field. 34 of 37 are the fixed broken plural ءَالَآء ('the Lord's bestowed favors/bounties'), a lexicalized noun always in construct with the divine (رَبّ / ٱللَّه) and always the object of an acknowledgment verb — to be remembered (7:69, 7:74), not doubted (53:55), or not denied (the 31x Surah-55 refrain plus its 53:55 twin). The remaining 3 are finite verbs in three different forms with three different argument frames, all in the privative/withholding zone: يَأْلُونَ (Form I, 3:118) 'fall short / stint / spare no effort'; يُؤْلُونَ (Form IV, 2:226) 'swear a binding oath of conjugal abstention'; and يَأْتَلِ (Form VIII, 24:22), irreducibly ambiguous between 'swear not to give' and 'fall short of giving.' The noun (bestowed favor) and the verbs (withholding/stinting) sit at opposite poles of a notional giving axis, but the Quran nowhere links them: no shared collocation, no derivational base token, no occurrence bridging favor to swearing/falling-short. Because the bridge across the two classes is not Quran-internally demonstrated, the honest result is an unresolved, multi-class partition rather than a forced single nucleus. Each class is separately coherent (the noun cleanly, the verb only loosely across its own three forms), but no root-wide meaning survives.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: The nominal ءَالَآء does NOT carry any verbal or withholding force: it is exclusively a received benefit, always plural, always in construct with the divine, always an object of acknowledgment (remember / do-not-deny / do-not-doubt), never an agent or an act, never human-to-human giving, never harm. The verbs do NOT mean 'bounty/favor' and never occur in construct with the divine; they are privative. The Form IV 'oath' sense (2:226) is specifically a self-binding oath of abstention (fixed by تَرَبُّص أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُر + resolution فَآءُو), NOT generic swearing and NOT reducible to Form I's plain 'fall short.' The verbal class is itself not a single lexeme: مِن-government (2:226), double accusative (3:118), and أَن-complement (24:22) are three distinct valencies. The root does NOT exhibit a single distinctive abstract meaning; any gloss wide enough to cover 'divine favors' + 'swear abstention' + 'stint effort' has no predictive content and is forbidden as a fit-everything abstraction.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: Juxtapose 2:226:2:1 يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ('those who swear to withhold from their wives') against 55:13:2:1 / 53:55:2:1 ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا/رَبِّكَ ('the bounties of your Lord'). A single nucleus must make 'swearing to withhold conjugal relations' and 'granted divine bounties' instances of one meaning — but they are opposite in direction of transfer (withholding vs. bestowing) and share zero Quran-internal collocational or morphological bridge. If the nucleus is 'favor/bounty' (the 92% reading), 2:226 disproves it; if the nucleus is 'binding withholding/restraint,' the ءَالَآء refrain disproves it. No single nucleus escapes both blocs; this pair is the decisive evidence that the QAC bucket is a homographic/derivational conflation, not a semantic unity.

layer_attribution.lexical_class: Two lexicalized classes sharing only the consonantal skeleton ا-ل-و: (A) nominal ءَالَآء = divine bestowed favor (object of acknowledgment); (B) privative verb = withhold / fall short / swear-abstention. Class A is the dominant lexicalized nominal mass (92% of tokens, but ~3 distinct environments).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextually the noun sits in praise/dhikr/denial-rebuke frames (remember → succeed 7:69; do not corrupt 7:74; do not doubt 53:55; do not deny, Surah-55 refrain) and the verbs in legal/social withholding frames (conjugal īlā' 2:226; malicious stinting 3:118; withholding charity to kin 24:22); these contextual/narrative roles are recorded but are NOT elevated into a root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 24:22 was reconciled from a tentative CONSISTENT verbal assignment to STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY because its oath-vs-shortfall ambiguity is irreducible; the noun class remains internally CONSISTENT within its own account while still failing to bridge to the verbs, so no reconciliation forces a unified nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The root-level unification is unresolved: the noun (bestow) and verb (withhold) classes are near-antonymic and unbridged in the corpus, and the verbal class is itself under-unified (3 forms, 3 valencies, one irreducibly ambiguous token). This persisted resistance is the honest terminal result, not a failure of analysis.

hard_cases.reason: The Form IV sworn conjugal abstention (يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ) is near-antonymic to the nominal 'bestowed favor' class and shares no Quran-internal bridge with it; it also resists reduction to Form I 'fall short,' being load-bearing on the sworn/legal 4-month dimension.

evidence_basis.statement: Swearing to withhold conjugal relations (2:226) and granted divine bounties (55:13 / 53:55) are opposite in direction of transfer and share zero Quran-internal collocational or morphological bridge.

hard_cases.reason: The Form I 'fall short / spare no effort' (لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا) is malicious stinting toward believers — the semantic opposite of the divine favor one is challenged not to deny; no single non-empty gloss covers both.

evidence_basis.statement: 3:118 malicious all-out effort to ruin (withholding no effort) set against the Surah-55 ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا (favor to be acknowledged) admits no single unifying gloss.

hard_cases.reason: The Form VIII token is irreducibly ambiguous between 'swear not to give' and 'fall short of giving,' so it neither unifies the verbal class internally nor bridges to the noun; its 'bounty' anchor is ٱلْفَضْل (root F-D-L), not ءَالَآء, so any noun-verb bridge here is thematic, not lexical.

evidence_basis.statement: 24:22 co-fits both the oath and the fall-short senses with nothing internal deciding; co-fitting of two independent senses is underdetermination, not unification, and its ٱلْفَضْل pairing is a thematic not lexical link.

hard_cases.reason: Representative of the 31x Surah-55 refrain (فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ): the dominant lexicalized nominal 'divine bounty' mass that resists any verbal nucleus, while its 31-fold repetition is one evidential environment, not independent corroboration.

evidence_basis.statement: The Surah-55 refrain ءَالَآء is a frozen divine-bounty plural in construct with the divine, patterning with acknowledgment/denial and never with any restraint notion; it cannot be routed through the verbal withholding sense.

hard_cases.reason: The doubt-frame twin (فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ) confirms the noun is exclusively an object of acknowledgment/doubt about received favor, with no verbal or withholding force, resisting unification with the verbs.

evidence_basis.statement: 53:55 presents ءَالَآء as bounty wrongly doubted — a received benefit, never an act of swearing or stinting.

hard_cases.reason: The remembrance-frame (فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ) makes the referents explicit graces already listed in-verse (made successors, expanded in creation) to be gratefully remembered — positive bestowal, the opposite pole from the verbal withholding, with no bridge across.

evidence_basis.statement: The noun ءَالَآء (7:69/7:74) is a substantive object of ٱذْكُرُوا۟ denoting bestowed goods; no Quranic occurrence derives it from or links it to any Alw verb.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The resistance is not a minority sub-class but a genuine unbridged partition: a dominant lexicalized nominal class (ءَالَآء, favor) and a small privative verbal class (withhold/stint/swear-abstention) that is itself internally under-unified. No Quran-internal bridge (collocational, derivational, or contextual) links the two classes, and 24:22 does not resolve even the intra-verbal split. The listed occurrences are the seam/boundary tokens that jointly demonstrate why no single nucleus holds; the root result is UNRESOLVED multi-class rather than a forced unity.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A demonstrated Quran-internal bridge — collocational, derivational, or contextual — linking the nominal ءَالَآء class to the verbal withholding/stinting class, which would collapse the current two-class partition into a single defensible nucleus and overturn the UNRESOLVED verdict.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 37 Alw occurrences plus any verse where ءَالَآء co-occurs with an Alw verb, or where an Alw verb produces or governs a bounty/favor object; specifically re-examine 24:22 (يَأْتَلِ + أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟) and the 7:69/7:74 remembrance frames for any morphological path from verb to the plural noun.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether a single narrow gloss predicts each occurrence's argument frame and truth-conditions without post-hoc reversal; require the bridge to be lexical (shared root token or derivation) rather than thematic, and reproducible across at least two independent syntactic environments in each class.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude thematic/pragmatic pairings that use a different root for 'bounty' (e.g., ٱلْفَضْل, root F-D-L, in 24:22); discount the 31x Surah-55 refrain as one evidential environment, not 31; reject any gloss so abstract it also fits unrelated give/withhold contexts (fit-everything abstraction).
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such bridge is found, the two-class partition stands and the root remains UNRESOLVED / multi-class; if a genuine lexical bridge is found, reopen to a DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY claim and re-grade the unified account.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal derivational or collocational link is established between the nominal ءَالَآء (e.g., 7:69/7:74, 53:55, Surah-55 refrain) and any Alw verb (2:226 يُؤْلُونَ, 3:118 يَأْلُونَ, 24:22 يَأْتَلِ), such that the noun and verb are shown to inflect one nucleus rather than two homographic classes.

If 24:22:2:1 (يَأْتَلِ) is Quran-internally disambiguated between 'swear (an oath not to give)' and 'fall short of giving,' resolving the intra-verbal split and allowing the three verb forms (I/IV/VIII) to be graded as a single verbal lexeme.
If a singular of ءَالَآء or a productive verbal derivation yielding it is attested in-corpus, converting the frozen plural into a live member of the verbal family.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: There is no unified root claim to falsify: the result is an UNRESOLVED, unbridged two-class partition. Adversarial testing (Lens C and the aggregation) sought the strongest unifier ('giving-axis / withholding-vs-release polarity') and refuted it as a post-hoc reversal with no Quran-internal warrant. Because the honest verdict is unresolved-class-only, a unified-claim falsification run is NOT_REQUIRED; distinctiveness_ok is false precisely because no single distinctive nucleus survives.
